thesis: Transform the enterprise around the network.
dek: Connect customer, commercial and operational work through bounded, evidence-tested workflows. Keep network control with your NEP and NOC, and give every consequential action a clear owner.
opportunity: The enterprise around the network contains recurring decisions across service, sales, billing, assurance and internal operations. Start with a measurable workflow, not a promise of universal autonomy.

pressures.title: Margin needs resolved work
pressures.body: Reducing service effort matters only when resolution quality, repeat contact and customer harm remain visible.

pressures.title: Fragmented context slows decisions
pressures.body: Connect permitted records across existing systems without making a new data lake a prerequisite.

pressures.title: Integration is not authority
pressures.body: An available API is not permission to issue credits, suspend a SIM, change tariffs or alter infrastructure.

reversal.title: More autonomy is not the objective.
reversal.body: Exposure sets the ceiling and evidence earns authority within it. Choose the least authority that achieves the intended outcome with accountable intervention and recovery.

myth.claim: “One master agent can run the enterprise.”
myth.verdict: No. Domain-limited orchestration coordinates approved work; business owners, network teams and partners retain their responsibilities.

selectedWork.description: Bring the workflow, its current baseline and the people accountable for decisions. Agree a bounded evidence plan before expanding authority.

telecomPov.note: Figures are sourced outcomes reported at other operators or illustrative KPI targets. They are not Cognirise delivery results or guarantees; applicability depends on operator context.

valuePools.title: Revenue integrity
valuePools.body: Reconcile leakage, investigate fraud and separate recovery from overlapping savings.

valuePools.title: Service & customer experience
valuePools.body: Improve resolved service, not containment or call avoidance alone.

valuePools.title: Growth — marketing & CVM
valuePools.body: Test relevant offers and retention with consent and fair treatment.

valuePools.title: Roaming & wholesale
valuePools.body: Improve settlements and partner decisions while preserving network ownership.

valuePools.title: Billing & disputes
valuePools.body: Explain charges and prepare corrections within financial and change-control limits.

valuePools.title: Sales acceleration
valuePools.body: Prepare timely, qualified commercial handoffs rather than optimise low-quality lead volume.

architecture.orchestration: Domain-limited orchestration delegates named tasks with scoped identities, purpose-limited context and explicit handoffs. No omnipotent master agent or unrestricted shared memory.
architecture.domains: Business, Operations and Foundations collaborate through approved evidence and action contracts. Selecting a department highlights its application path; this is a Telecom application view, not a replacement CogniOS model.
architecture.foundation: Reuse permissioned OSS/BSS, CRM, billing, partner records and read-only telemetry. Integrate supported APIs, reviewed adapters and semantic mappings where appropriate; a new data lake is not required and orchestration is not model training.
architecture.execution: Owner-authorised workflows enforce permissions, approvals, intervention, audit and recovery. NEP/NOC retains network control. Partner systems and platform capabilities retain their existing ownership.

scenarios.title: Billing dispute investigation
scenarios.boundary: Credits and dispute settlements require financial limits and named approval. Rating-engine patches require tested change control and rollback; never silently change charging.
scenarios.auditRecovery: Record input provenance, proposed action, approver, executed change and verification. Stop on unexpected impact; restore the prior approved state or open a compensating case when reversal is not possible.

stages.detect: A disputed invoice and customer explanation enter the billing case queue.
stages.investigate: Retrieve permitted billing records, check identity, freshness and contradictory evidence; request missing context rather than guessing.
stages.propose: Prepare a reasoned billing dispute investigation recommendation with alternatives, expected impact and the action-specific permission required.
stages.approveExecute: Credits and dispute settlements require financial limits and named approval. Rating-engine patches require tested change control and rollback; never silently change charging. Record approval before using the authorised execution interface; otherwise hand off without taking action.
stages.verify: Confirm the intended outcome, check customer and service impact, and compare the defined KPI with the agreed baseline. Close only with owner-accepted evidence.

rafm.title: Revenue assurance & fraud, connected by evidence
rafm.body: Correlate usage, billing and partner evidence without merging all data into a new lake. Keep leakage and fraud cases distinct, avoid double-counting recovery, and join investigations through permissioned case references.

capabilityRange.title: Manual
capabilityRange.body: People perform the work with documented evidence.
capabilityRange.controls: Named ownership, access controls and reviewable records.

capabilityRange.title: Assisted
capabilityRange.body: Tools assemble information and suggest options; people decide and act.
capabilityRange.controls: Source checking, professional review and no unapproved writes.
capabilityRange.appropriate: Ambiguous work that benefits from human judgment.

capabilityRange.title: Automated
capabilityRange.controls: Tested rules, bounded permissions, monitoring and recovery.
capabilityRange.appropriate: Stable, repeatable actions with clear exception paths.

capabilityRange.title: Orchestrated
capabilityRange.body: Permissioned workflows coordinate work across accountable teams.
capabilityRange.controls: Domain isolation, action-specific approval, audit and intervention.
capabilityRange.appropriate: Evidence-rich journeys with explicit handoffs and approvals.

capabilityRange.title: Bounded delegated action
capabilityRange.body: Tested workflows act within a deliberately limited authority envelope.
capabilityRange.controls: Exposure sets the ceiling; evidence earns authority within it. Stop conditions, monitoring and tested recovery remain mandatory.
capabilityRange.appropriate: Only where exposure permits and evidence supports delegated action; not a required destination.

delivery.innovate: Assess the process, prioritise hypotheses and define the operator baseline, exposure and accountable owner.
delivery.demonstrate: Generate bounded evidence with a scoped pilot, comparison design, explicit stop conditions and customer-impact measures.
delivery.activate: Integrate production interfaces, authorise actions, rehearse intervention and recovery, and prepare accountable teams.
delivery.operate: Monitor outcomes, cost and harm; review evidence and permissions, improve through approved changes and retire ineffective workflows.

telecomPov.marketConstraints: For the selected edition, review data residency, lawful purpose, retention, cross-border processing, customer consent, complaints and telecom consumer protection with qualified local owners. Network and partner approvals remain explicit. This is not a compliance assurance; launch depends on edition-specific legal and operational review.

entryPoints.title: Readiness conversation
entryPoints.body: Bring a process and its baseline to a Value Scan; assess the decision and evidence gaps within Innovate.

entryPoints.title: Scoped pilot
entryPoints.body: Agree an evidence plan within Demonstrate. Timing and production scope depend on access, integration and approval—not a fixed-day promise.

entryPoints.title: Innovation workshop
entryPoints.body: Explore adaptation hypotheses and prioritise work within Innovate; use the same delivery and authority model.

metrics.name: Cost per resolved contact
metrics.definition: Total scoped service cost divided by resolved contacts; relative reduction versus the same channel mix and baseline period.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Sales cycle duration
metrics.definition: Median days from accepted qualified lead to signed contract for comparable products; relative reduction versus the operator baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Subscriber churn rate
metrics.definition: Subscribers leaving in the measurement period divided by subscribers at period start; relative reduction versus a comparable untreated cohort.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Disputes resolved within approved authority
metrics.definition: Disputes fully resolved without repeat contact in the agreed observation window divided by eligible disputes; approval-required decisions remain excluded.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Manual data-entry effort
metrics.definition: Staff minutes spent entering scoped records at matched volume and accuracy; relative reduction versus operator baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Digital sales completions
metrics.definition: Completed digital purchases in matched periods, with cancellations and channel displacement reported separately; relative increase versus baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Confirmed revenue leakage rate
metrics.definition: Confirmed unbilled or misrated eligible usage value divided by total eligible usage value; relative reduction versus operator baseline, excluding fraud overlap.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Confirmed fraud loss rate
metrics.definition: Confirmed fraud losses net of recovery divided by scoped revenue, with false positives and customer harm reported separately; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Net Promoter Score
metrics.definition: Percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors on the same survey population. Changes are percentage points, not relative percent.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Roaming settlement duration
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from period close to agreed settlement for comparable partners; relative reduction versus operator baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Wholesale billing dispute rate
metrics.definition: Disputed invoices divided by invoices issued in comparable periods and partner scope; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Bad debt rate
metrics.definition: Written-off receivables divided by billed revenue for matched cohorts and observation windows; relative reduction, monitored alongside fairness and hardship outcomes.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Time to approved insight
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from accepted analytical request to validated result at matched complexity; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Customer record quality

metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Offer conversion rate
metrics.definition: Accepted eligible offers divided by delivered eligible offers within an agreed attribution window. Absolute rate and relative uplift are different measurements.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Lead-to-meeting conversion

metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.
